notes.subject: ne
notes.rationale: Hebrew bɛ argu fɔlɔ dɔrɔn; nɔnabila 'ne' farala a kan ka kuma jɛya

notes.subject: חקתיך / חומתיך
notes.rationale: ḥaqotikha / ḥomotayikh — kunkan-ɲɛnama fila; Bamanankan tɛ se ka o lamini jira

notes.subject: Siye
notes.rationale: Yawe bɛ fɔ Siye de ye (49:14–17 kɔnɔ), a ye tɔgɔ weleli ye

notes.subject: i ka boliw
notes.rationale: חקתיך 'm'i kɔnɔ' a b'a fɔ mɔgɔ ye walima dugu ka boliw ye — 'i' (Siye) walima 'i ka boliw' (Yerushalayim) dibagaw bɛ sɔsɔ

translation: Aw, ne m'i kɔnɔ ⟨ne⟩ bolibuw la; i ka boliw bɛ ⟨ne⟩ ɲɛfɛ ɲɔɔnin bɛɛ.
